mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the correlation between the interaction term and SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 105), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as production bottlenecks reduce corporate profitability and increase inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly adds signals strong labor market growth, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), elevated residential construction (HOUST above its 12-month moving average) signals overheating demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5% and HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 106) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 106.
